liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **C C Rider** (2 other sources): Spencer Davis sang it as Easy Rider with variations; the last prior C.C. Rider was 04-03-87; Spencer Davis sang it as Easy Rider; the last prior C.C. Rider was 04-03-87 [1][2]
- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Jack Straw is singled out for its energy; The Jack Straw into China/Rider sequence was amazing [21][29]
- **Stella Blue** (2 reviews): Stella Blue stands out, with Jerry sounding special; Stella Blue and Baby Blue were wonderful, from a loge seat on Jerry's side [22][23]
- **We Can Run** (1 other source): Brent's absence is felt strongly on We Can Run But We Can't Hide [10]
- **I'm A Man** (1 review): I'm A Man is one of the best guest appearances; the band huddled first, Phil had a strong intro, and Jerry ripped [29]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat contains an extended jam [21]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Bruce Hornsby sitting in played an accordion and piano solo during Rider [25]
- **Man Smart (Woman Smarter)** (1 review): MIDI horn sounds in Women Are Smarter were funny, with Jerry playing exuberantly [28]

## Setlist highlights

- **audience**: rare: 12 archived performances [30]
- **I'm A Man**: back after 1254 archived shows (6469 days); rare: 3 archived performances [30]
- **audience**: rare: 12 archived performances [30]
- **Garcia/Weir Interview, Rockline KLOS 95.5 fm**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-12-10.fob.french.brown.83792.sbeok.flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 22 songs; 177 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd89-12-10.sbd.ladner.5451.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 156 min; rated 4.43/5 by 14 [3]
- **gd1989-12-10.sbd.ladner.16669.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 156 min [10]. Said about its sound: Hornsby's accordion is prominent throughout the recording [10]
- **gd1989-12-10.146096.Senn-MKE2002.french.flac1644**: source not stated; 22 songs; 177 min [2]

## Around the show

- Bruce Hornsby visibly struggled to keep up with the band during the jams, which the reviewer found delightful [18]
- During China/Rider a huge beach ball landed onstage; Jerry kicked it back into the crowd, and the crowd erupted [23]
- Spencer Davis waited backstage before joining; the reviewer, on the floor near the tapers, recognized C.C. Rider from its first note [24]
- Reviewer celebrated a 21st birthday, ended up watching from backstage, and recalls jets flying low overhead [27]
- Bruce Hornsby played accordion on Sugaree through I Know You Rider; Spencer Davis sang and played guitar on C.C. Rider and I'm A Man [1]
- Hornsby played accordion on Sugaree, Jack Straw, China Cat and Rider, and piano on Woman Smarter and Good Lovin' [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-12-10.fob.french.brown.83792.sbeok.flac24**: taped by Mike French; transferred by Scott Brown conversion to flac; source: Sennheiser MKE2002 omni's HRTF -> Sony TC-D5M. Mics at 6'5". Also covering an ortf pair of Neumann km84's -> Sony TC-D5M rig, on a stand. [1]
- **gd89-12-10.sbd.ladner.5451.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > CDR > WAV > SHNv3 [3]. Also: Soundboard to DAT to CDR to WAV to SHN; extracted by C. Ladner from a Charlie Miller seed [3]
- **gd1989-12-10.sbd.ladner.16669.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Charlie Miller; transferred by Chris Ladner; source: SBD > DAT > CDR > WAV > SHNv3 [10]
- **gd1989-12-10.146096.Senn-MKE2002.french.flac1644**: taped by Mike French; transferred by Mike French, Scott Brown; source: Sennheiser MKE2002 omni's HRTF -> Sony TC-D5M. Mics at 6'5" FOB/DFC (same spot as 2/89 run, and all 12/89 run) Also covering an ortf pair of Neumann km84's ->… [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1989-12-10 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1989-12-10-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [31]
